B2B founder-led sales for restaurants & bars. Thoughts on Instantly.ai vs other lead gen tools?
Hi all, I’m preparing to go to market with founder led sales for a B2B startup. Target customers are restaurant and bar owners/ operators.

I’m evaluating tools for pulling contact info and running outbound, and [Instantly.ai](http://Instantly.ai) keeps coming up. I’ve also been told by a few people to stay away from Apollo for this specific use case.

Curious if anyone here has:

Used Instantly for local SMB / hospitality outreach

Found it effective (or not) for owner/operator contacts

Alternative tools or workflows you’d recommend for this niche

Not looking for a total AI outreach solution and agents right now, just trying to avoid bad data and wasted effort. Appreciate any honest takes!
